title: Public Sector Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with justifying the existence of governments and explaining how they can affect economic activity."
Public sector economics is concerned with justifying the existence of governments and explaining how they can affect economic activity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which are free to use and therefore there is no cost involved in usage of such products whereas for private product one has to pay in order to use them. 2."
Public goods are those which are free to use and therefore there is no cost involved in usage of such products whereas for private product one has to pay in order to use them. 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as the ‗welfare state'."
The modern state is described as the ‗welfare state'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an innovative technique to guard against wastage in public expenditure."
Zero base budgeting is an innovative technique to guard against wastage in public expenditure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which are repayable within a short period, usually less than a year."
Floating or unfunded loans are those which are repayable within a short period, usually less than a year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the calculation of the wealth and income of a nation once it is divided by its total population."
Distribution of Income Distribution of income is the calculation of the wealth and income of a nation once it is divided by its total population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important virtue when dealing with the masses of people involved in taxation but it is not easily realized."
Simplicity is an important virtue when dealing with the masses of people involved in taxation but it is not easily realized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with benefits derived over a much longer period of time than private business can afford."
Often government is concerned with benefits derived over a much longer period of time than private business can afford.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that no one can be denied the service."
Non- excludable means that no one can be denied the service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important component of a free market system."
The concept of competition is an important component of a free market system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who consumes a good without paying for it."
A free rider is a person who consumes a good without paying for it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a near-public good i.e. it has many but not all the characteristics of a public good."
A quasi-public good is a near-public good i.e. it has many but not all the characteristics of a public good.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the standard that economists use to evaluate a variety of resources."
Economic Efficiency Economic efficiency is the standard that economists use to evaluate a variety of resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a consequence of an economic activity experienced by unrelated third parties; it can be either positive or negative."
An externality is a consequence of an economic activity experienced by unrelated third parties; it can be either positive or negative.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the government loans floated in the capital markets within the country."
Internal debt refers to the government loans floated in the capital markets within the country.
fib: ______ is the overall value of a population's physical possessions and financial assets.
Wealth
Wealth is the overall value of a population's physical possessions and financial assets.
______ are considered to be technical externalities.
Almost all externalities
Almost all externalities are considered to be technical externalities.
______ is an example of market failure that incorporates both non- excludability and externality.
Traffic congestion
Traffic congestion is an example of market failure that incorporates both non- excludability and externality.
______ is used to achieve economic and social reforms.
Taxation sometimes
Taxation sometimes is used to achieve economic and social reforms.
______ are used both for revenue and for regulation and control.
Licenses and permits
Licenses and permits are used both for revenue and for regulation and control.
______ refers to the effect changes in economic condition have upon revenue yield.
stability of taxes
Stability The stability of taxes refers to the effect changes in economic condition have upon revenue yield.
______ are the penalties for not conforming to law.
Fines
Fines are the penalties for not conforming to law.
______ is a tax which results in a decrease in the tax rate as the amount subject to taxation increases.
regressive tax
Regressive Tax System A regressive tax is a tax which results in a decrease in the tax rate as the amount subject to taxation increases.

______ are defined as public goods that could be delivered as private goods, but are usually delivered by the government for various reasons, including social policy, and funded via public funds like taxes.
Social goods

Social goods Social goods are defined as public goods that could be delivered as private goods, but are usually delivered by the government for various reasons, including social policy, and funded via public funds like taxes.
______ is the ultimate indicator that is used by consumers and producers to communicate with each other.
Price
Price is the ultimate indicator that is used by consumers and producers to communicate with each other.
______ is the exact monetary value of a population's net intake over a selected period of time.
Income
Income is the exact monetary value of a population's net intake over a selected period of time.
______ is the tool generally undertaken by the government for the welfare of the entire society.
cost benefit analysis
The cost benefit analysis is the tool generally undertaken by the government for the welfare of the entire society.
______ is concerned with the operations of the fiscal or public treasury.
Public finance
Public finance is concerned with the operations of the fiscal or public treasury.
______ is used for the benefit of poor people through subsidies, allowance, and other types of direct and indirect benefits to them. 5.
money collected
The money collected is used for the benefit of poor people through subsidies, allowance, and other types of direct and indirect benefits to them. 5.
